---
name: Feature request
about: Propose one improvement to a game or the terminal experience.
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem or use case
<!-- Which game or terminal workflow would this improve? Explain the current limitation and who it affects. -->

## Proposed feature and expected behavior
<!--
Describe the change from a player's perspective and give a short example of the expected behavior.
You do not need to know how to implement it.
-->

## Alternatives considered
<!--
What can a player do today instead? Explain why that workaround or another approach does not meet the need.
If you have not found an alternative, say so.
-->

## Additional context (optional)
<!-- Add a relevant example, sketch, or screenshot. Omit personal information; remove this section if unused. -->

## Checklist
- [ ] I searched existing issues for similar requests.
- [ ] This request describes one feature or improvement.
